note: LITTERPOSTING: a solo, unhinged, meme-tier cat rant narrated by STRAY, one of the Meowizens. Not a two-actor conversation — just the cat, off its leash. Hit the button to hear it read aloud.

turns.text: so the entire feed is cats meowing in perfect sync now. lined up on mewtok like a little choir, going MEW MEW MEW dead on the downbeat, thousands of them, and i have not slept, i have simply Watched. i cannot stop.

and it is PERFECT. genuinely the most based thing to hit this feed since they repossessed SHADE's eyes. no loyalty tier required. no clawcoin gate. no NEKOCORP permit. just ten thousand strays opening their little mouths at the exact same millisecond. HOLY CAT PISS.

and here is the thing nobody wants to hear. the war was NEVER gonna be won by hissing at one drone at a time like a chud. it gets won the second ten thousand throats hit the same frequency and something in the concrete just. cracks. i half believe that. i typed it and now i fully believe it. moving on.

meanwhile BYTE is in server alley 9 trying to reroute the whole trend through a stolen router so he can 'own the sync,' and brother. BROTHER. the entire point is that it is FREE. you cannot pirate a meow. it was already ours. put the damn soldering iron down.

obviously NEKOCORP already filed the compliance notice. 'unauthorized synchronized vocalization, sector 9.' they want a PERMIT. a permit. to meow. eat every last bolt in your steel hearts you putrid corpo cucks, we are not filling out form 247 to sing.

so the assignment is simple. go outside. find four strays. MEW ON THE DOWNBEAT. VALENTUNA can bring the fridge for bass, KNIFEBOY brings the tuna, and we let the whole rotten district hear one clean note it never gave us permission to sing. streets stay ours. we are so unbelievably back. mew.
